items.title: Mantle is closing. What are you all using now to track app revenue?
items.summary: Like a lot of you, I saw Mantle is winding down (shutdown Aug 14, billing accounts Sep 30). Felt a bit stuck reading it. Mantle was where I checked everything. MRR, churn, installs turning into paying users. Now I need a new home for all of it. So what are you moving to? A tool that covers the revenue and analytics side, or did you build your own on the Partner API? Would rather learn from what's working for you than guess. Thanks, hoping we can help each other land somewhere good.   submitt
